model.architecture_family: decoder-only Transformer (Qwen2.5 architecture); LoRA adapter on frozen base weights
model.intended_use: Domain-adapted Chinese medical question-answering / dialogue assistant, produced by LoRA fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on Chinese medical Q&A pairs.
capabilities: Chinese medical Q&A (symptoms, medications, diseases, treatment advice)
retains base Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct general instruction-following via frozen base weights
limitations: Intended for Chinese medical Q&A only
Not a substitute for professional medical advice
Performance may vary on medical topics underrepresented in the training data
Evaluated only on a specific, undisclosed Chinese medical Q&A corpus (412 held-out samples, 50-sample subset scored); results may differ on other datasets

references.title: melc030/MedQwen (training code, evaluation scripts, Gradio demo — linked from HF card)

provenance.notes: Personal/community LoRA fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Author identity beyond the HF handle 'mellee030' (linked GitHub user 'melc030') and any organizational affiliation are not disclosed. base_model_name_or_path in adapter_config.json points to a local path ('/home/yuxincui/MedQwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct'), consistent with a local copy of the public Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct checkpoint rather than a modified base.

transformation.objective: Adapt Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Chinese medical question answering / dialogue while keeping the adapter lightweight and the base model's general capabilities intact.

hyperparameters.trainable_params_share: ~1% of base model parameters (per HF card)

transformation.notes: Trained on a single GCP L4 GPU (24GB VRAM); training time ~12 hours per HF card. HF repo was created 2026-04-17 and last modified 2026-04-18, used only as a rough proxy for release timing since no explicit training/release date is stated.

datasets.name: MedQwen-7B-LoRA Chinese medical dialogue pairs (30,284)
datasets.description: 30,284 Chinese medical Q&A dialogue pairs covering symptoms, medications, diseases, and treatment advice; converted to the Qwen2.5 chat template format (system/user/assistant).
processing: converted to Qwen2.5 chat template (system/user/assistant roles)

configuration.notes: ROUGE is lower for the fine-tuned model because it learns concise, on-format answers rather than verbose outputs (per HF card).
Card states BERTScore is the primary metric for open-ended Chinese generation.

safety.risk_level: Low-scope community domain adapter; card explicitly disclaims clinical use and provides no formal safety evaluation.

items.description: Not a substitute for professional medical advice.
Performance may vary on medical topics underrepresented in the training data.
Evaluated on a specific Chinese medical Q&A corpus (undisclosed source/composition); results may differ on other datasets or domains.
Intended for Chinese medical Q&A only; behavior outside this domain/language is not characterized.
